attackers_goals: Attackers might use WebDAV as a C&C or exfiltration channel to evade detection and firewall rules.
description: Attackers may mount a WebDAV drive over HTTPS to upload files to and download files from a compromised machine.
investigative_actions: Check whether the initiator process is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it. Check whether additional malicious commands were executed from the same process.
name: WebDAV drive mounted from net.exe over HTTPS
